question: How is the cosmic egg supported and described by authoritative teachers?
premises: That structure supports the cosmic egg.
It does so by its own power on all sides.
The teachers in the Raurava and other scriptures describe it as having the form of an egg.
inference: The cosmic egg is a self-supported, all-encompassing egg-shaped structure affirmed by scriptural authorities.
plain_english: That which supports the cosmic egg does so by its own power on all sides. The teachers, in the Raurava and other scriptures, have said that it has the form of an egg.
